subplayer.release_notes: v1.3.2: PITCH knob restored (master + all 16 per-pad pitch params, -24..+24 semitones, default 0). Old sessions keep their pitch values. Knob values still carry when scrolling the bank, CHOKE stays global and ON, UPDATE button wired to the live feed.

lock.release_notes: First release. Automatic vocal alignment: always listening, captures on vocal, aligns dubs to the lead. Never mutes your live vocal.

looplab.release_notes: v1.3.0: User-approved interface rebuild (dark indigo/violet) with integrated LOOP BANK: searchable browser, N loops counter, click + arrow-key selection with auto-play preview. GROSS knobs (STUTTER, HALF-TIME, GATE). Waveform with trim shading, TRIM L/R sliders, KEY/BPM pills, CHOP toggle, drag-export.

hub.release_notes: v1.0.2: Fixed the crash on launch for the owner-stats path (SIGABRT in the stats worker teardown — the result callback no longer destroys its own worker thread). Downloaded plugin files now also land in ~/Documents/KTTB Plugins/<name>/ so you can move them wherever you like.
